{{Quote|I have the signal! Great work. Follow the coordinates and see what's there.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DFtC" />}}
A '''cave''' located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was used as the base of operation of the [[cave-dwellers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Listen, they know that they are in trouble. A transmission just came from there threatening to kill their hostages. Do whatever you must to save them. I'll transfer all the information that I have to you.|Commander Talte, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DFtC" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the cave was inhabited by the cave-dwellers,<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] group of anti-government criminals led by [[Raynod Menar]].<ref name="SWG:DFR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Final Reckoning|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:Psychotic_cave-dwellers_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Psychotic cave-dwellers keeping hostages in a cave.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> psychotic cave-dwellers captured two groups of hikers in the Thaos Mountains.<ref name="SWG:DFtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Finding the Culprits|Corellia}}</ref> [[Ilyamo]] and other hikers were kept as hostages in the cave.<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Rescue|Corellia}}</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] therefore hired a spacer to investigate the disappearances of the hikers.<ref name="SWG:DGI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Disappearances: Gathering Information</ref> The spacer fought several cave-dwellers at the spot where the second group disappeared. From a communicator found on a body, the spacer managed to triangulate a signal to the cave.<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> The CorSec finally assaulted the cave and freed the hostages.<ref name="SWG:DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The psychotic cave-dwellers' cave appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The cave was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
